description: 한국도로공사_고속도로 차량감지장치(VDS) 오류 및 장애 데이터 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 고속도로 노선상에 설치된 차량감지장치(VDS)는 루프검지를 이용한 지점별 교통정보로서 VDS지점별 루프 오류 및 장애와 교통량, 점유율, 속도 등의 검지 결과를 30초 주기마다 수집하는. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 오류, 장애, VDS, 설비운영, 유지보수. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
